name: Persona 3: Dancing in Moonlight - Chibi Velvet Room Residents + Zen & Rei Set
summary: A set of 8 chibi-character accessories (Elizabeth, Theodore, Margaret, Marie, Justine, Caroline, Zen, and Rei) for all characters. This item is compatible with both Persona 3: Dancing in Moonlight and Persona 5: Dancing in Starlight on PS4.
